title: Choice Benefits in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program
content:
A Crestline Summit Loyalty Program member at Summit Platinum, Summit Diamond or Summit Chairman earns the tier's number of choice-benefit selections for each qualification year in which that tier was earned, and makes them one at a time.

## Selections remaining

The selections already made for a qualification year are the selection entries on the membership that carry that qualification year. A new selection is accepted only while that count is below the number of selections of the tier held.

| Tier held | Selections already made for the year | New selection accepted |
|---|---|---|
| Summit Platinum (1 selection) | 0 | Yes |
| Summit Platinum (1 selection) | 1 | No |
| Summit Diamond (2 selections) | 1 | Yes |
| Summit Chairman (3 selections) | 3 | No |

## The options

Each selection is one of the following.

- **Upgrade certificates.** Summit Upgrade Certificates expiring the tier's certificate validity months, in calendar months, after issue. The former wording that this option "issues the tier's upgrade certificates per selection of Summit Upgrade Certificates" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for a choice-benefit certificate issue.
- **Bonus miles.** The former wording that this option "credits the tier's bonus miles per selection" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for a choice-benefit bonus credit.
- **Companion certificate**, available only when the tier's chart shows the companion certificate as available; it issues one companion certificate under the Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes charter.
- **Club membership**, available only when the tier's chart shows the club membership as available; it enrolls the member in a one-year Summit Club Individual membership under the Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships charter.

## Finality and lapse

A selection is final once made and cannot be exchanged for another option. Unmade selections lapse at the end of the valid-through date of the tier that earned them. Choice-benefit bonus miles do not count as qualifying activity.
